نشتوي (form VIII)
# نَشْتَوِي (naštawī) /naʃ.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# نَشْتَوِيَ (naštawiya) /naʃ.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
